functional: same absolute physical GFN2 plus existing frozen responses; core eigensystem is only an AO chart, never an S0 solution
ground_excitation_gap: not evaluated during a total-excited-energy geometry calculation
tracking: full CSF overlap >=0.7 from last accepted point for each component; active-pair overlap >=0.7 across the explicitly different full/spectral Hamiltonians
initial_anchor: retained for diagnostics; original active character may evolve continuously along the connected electronic branch; no hard long-path overlap threshold
saddle_indices: same initial indices and bounded adjacent-index following; component indices remain certified
qualification: unchanged max force 3e-5 Ha/bohr, exact relaxed analytic Hessian, no vibrational mode below -20 cm^-1, central-gradient Hessian-vector checks at 2e-4 and 1e-4 bohr
accuracy: compare certified geometry with existing published references; connected-state relaxation does not by itself establish spectroscopic n/pi purity or accuracy
restart: migrate last accepted checkpoints, preserve anchors and reused optimizer Hessians; no recalibration or re-running completed parent phases
